data_description.group_probe_enabled: Speaker groups are probed through their leader. Turn off if a group buffers forever when probed (pychromecast issue 1197).
data_description.probe_video_devices: Off by default: launching the media receiver on a Chromecast with a display can turn on the connected TV through CEC.
